title: Planting the Orchard

readiness.math: measuring with a long unit; putting events in order (sequencing)
readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: These little apple trees need a home. Apple trees grow very big, so they need lots of room.

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: This long stick is how far apart they must be. One stick from the stone, then one stick more, and one more.

steps.speaker: miriam
steps.prompt: Put a peg for each tree. Each one is one long stick away from the last. Lay the stick down to measure.
steps.hint: Lay the stick next to the stone. Where does the other end reach? Put a peg there.

feedback.placed_all: Let's check with the stick. Does it fit each space?
feedback.crowded: Look: the stick covers a peg there. Those trees would be too close. Can that peg move further away?
feedback.far: Look: there's a gap past the end of the stick. Can that peg move closer?
feedback.all_good: Every space is one long stick. The trees will have room to grow.

steps.speaker: miriam
steps.prompt: How does an apple tree grow? Put the pictures in order, from the first to the last.
steps.hint: What comes first: the seed, or the tree?

older.prompt: How does an apple tree grow? Put the pictures in order. There are no words to help this time: look closely.

feedback.out_of_order: Some pictures are in the wrong place. They've gone back to the table. What comes next?
feedback.all_good: Seed, sprout, young tree, blossom, apples! That's how it grows.

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: Our trees are planted. It will be years before they give apples. We plant them for the children who come after us, too.

journal_line: I planted three young apple trees with Miss Miriam, one long stick apart, and put the pictures of how a tree grows in order.
unavailable_text: The apple trees are planted. Now they need time.
